description: This PHP source file provides functions to convert database recordsets into HTML tables, with features like pagination, header customization, and data formatting. It is part of the ADOdb database abstraction layer library.

methods.name: rs2html
methods.description: Converts a database recordset into an HTML table with optional headers and formatting.

methods.name: arr2html
methods.description: Converts a 2D array into an HTML table with optional headers.
